description: Sources Sought Notice N61331-26-SN-Q19For Advanced Synthetic Aperture Sonar Imaging eNgine (ASASIN) Software ModificationsThe purpose of this Sources Sought notice is to comply with the Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) 206.302-1(d) posting requirement. This is NOT a request for proposals.The Naval Surface Warfare Center Panama City Division (NSWC PCD) intends to award a sole source, firm-fixed-price contract to Pennsylvania State University Applied Research Laboratories (PSU ARL) (CAGE Code: 7A720) for modification to their proprietary Advanced Synthetic Aperture Sonar Imaging eNgine (ASASIN) software.
